institution: K.V.N. Naik College of Engineering & Technology, Nashik

primary_sources: Nashik Municipal Corporation (NMC) Kumbh Mela 2015 Cell Post-Event Traffic & Crowd Audit
Maharashtra State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA) Shahi Snan Crowd Inflow Telemetry
MSRTC Kumbh Special Division Satellite Parking & Shuttle Operations Logs
Nashik City Police & Trimbakeshwar Rural Police Traffic Advisory Geographic Shapefiles
OpenStreetMap (OSM) Godavari Basin High-Resolution Pedestrian Network Extract

algorithmic_applications_in_kumbh_saathi: Dynamic Rerouting Heuristics based on 2015 Shahi Snan bottleneck propagation curves
Persona-based walking velocity buffers (Elderly 0.74x, Wheelchair 0.68x, Solo 1.18x)
Crowd density classification boundaries: Low (0-30%), Moderate (30-60%), High (60-80%), Critical (>80%)
Satellite Parking to Sanctum transit matrix (P1 to P8 interconnects)
Stampede prevention penalty weights applied to narrow heritage alleys (<4.5m width)
